title: Customs Duty Exempted on Lithium-Ion Battery Machinery & Charger Parts till March 2029
summary: Customs Duty Exempted on Lithium-Ion Battery Machinery & Charger Parts till March 2029

items: Duty Exemptions: Customs duty exempted on automotive/medical display assembly parts, mobile wireless charging modules, and lithium-ion cell machinery till March 31, 2029.
Previous Duty Rates: Duties previously ranged from 7.5% to 15%.
